name: Linwood
blurb: A wide EF4 across the Kansas River valley between Lawrence and Kansas City, after weeks of record rain. Nobody was killed.
source: NOAA Storm Prediction Center tornado database (1950–2025)
pathFidelity: surveyed centrelines from NOAA's Damage Assessment Toolkit

torn.name: Osage–Douglas, KS
torn.comments: One of two tornadoes associated with a cyclic supercell storm. This tornado formed across northeast Osage County, producing a distinct damage path northeast into Douglas County.  The damage path of this tornado was tracked into the southeast parts of Lone Star Lake where it merged with an intensifying seperate mesocyclone to its northeast.

torn.name: Douglas–Leavenworth, KS
torn.comments: This violent tornado formed southwest of Lawrence Kansas and moved northeast through Leavenworth County producing EF4 damage in the Linwood area.  The tornado track appears to have been between 28 and 29 miles long with peak winds around 170 mph. More information can be found at: https://noaa.maps.arcgis.com/apps/MapJournal/index.html?appid=48ffcc24f3a14fea953373ca26d459ba
